title: I PRIORITIZE MYSELF
note: Not released. alt_text: A gold frequency ring glows around the NDCH arch-and-Y emblem on black stone veined with gold, under the title I PRIORITIZE MYSELF, NDCH FREQ 005. The picture pushes in slowly and the gold breathes brighter while one line repeats: I prioritize myself.
